name: Jotham
bio: Jotham, son of Azariah (Uzziah), governed Judah as regent while his father lived apart as a leper, then succeeded him as king at twenty-five, reigning sixteen years in Jerusalem; his mother was Jerusha, daughter of Zadok. He did right in the LORD's eyes, following his father's example, though the high places remained, and he built the upper gate of the temple (2 Kings 15:5, 32-35). In his days the LORD began to send Rezin, king of Syria, and Pekah against Judah (2 Kings 15:37). He died and was buried in the City of David, and his son Ahaz succeeded him (2 Kings 15:38).
